description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

>  您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh: 要查询的防护对象、防护组名称或防护资产ID。
description.en: The name of the protected object or protected object group, or the ID of the protected asset to query.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
The type of the protected resource.
The ID of the protection rule.
The name of the protection rule.

description.zh:
防护规则类型。取值：
- **defense**（默认）：防护规则
- **whitelist**：白名单规则
description.en:
The type of the protection rule. Valid values:
- **defense** (default): protection rule.
- **whitelist**: whitelist rule.

description.zh: 要查询的防护模板名称。
description.en: The name of the protection template to query.

title.zh: 查询防护对象或防护组的防护模板
title.en: Query protection templates of a protected object or protected object group

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-templates --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-9lb3600000e --resource mitsuichemicals.cn-waf --resource-type single --rule-type whitelist --rule-id 20111098 --rule-name demoRuleName --template-name test221 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aek2ax2y50000pi --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
